h: The Three Shabbos Meals Bring Creation Lasting Stability

p: corresponding to the holiness of the Avos:
סִידֵּר זוֹ לְיִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
he assigned this one to Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
and the morning one to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him
not in the order of their birth.
דְּכַד בָּרָא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא עָלְמָא
for when the Holy One, blessed be He, created the world,
and created the world with him.
He saw that it could not
and sustained the world through him," etc.;
"do not read be-hibar'am, 'when they were created,'
He saw that they needed greater endurance;
'On the day that Havayah Elokim made
That is, Yaakov is a chariot
"For Hashem is a sun and a shield";
and Yitzchak is a chariot for the Name Elokim:
And this is what Rashi writes in his commentary
to create it with the attribute of judgment;
He saw that the world would not endure,
and He put the attribute of mercy first
and joined it with the attribute of judgment;
and this is what is written,
the attributes of the Holy One, blessed be He;
whereas here, where it says "He took Yitzchak,"
does the holy Zohar have for this?
and so it says (Bereishis Rabbah, ch. 2):
but Yitzchak is not alluded to at all
in the creation of heaven and earth.
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (שַׁבָּת לא, ב)
לֹא בָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת עוֹלָמוֹ
"The Holy One, blessed be He, created His world
only so that they should fear Him,
so that they should fear Him'";
and likewise (end of chapter 6 of Avos, 6:11):
כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּעוֹלָמוֹ
"Everything the Holy One, blessed be He, created in His world
He created only for His glory,
'Everything that is called by My Name
and for My glory I have created it,' etc."
that the purpose of creation was
that the glory of His Kingship, blessed be His Name, should spread,
and "a king, that his fear be upon you"
וְזֶהוּ מִדַּת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and this is the attribute of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
as it is written, "the Fear of Yitzchak,"
And so we do not find
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּשֶׁב, פד, ד)
as they said (Bereishis Rabbah, beginning of Vayeshev, 84:4):
and where have we heard?" etc.:
from the converts of his father."
that all the converts that Avraham his father made
for according to his attribute he wanted
under the wings of the Shechinah
in his lifetime they kept the covenant of Avraham,
they returned to their bad ways and broke the covenant
and there is no trustworthiness in slaves;
כִּי כָּל עֲבָדִים שֶׁנִּמְלוּ עִם אַבְרָהָם
for all the slaves that were circumcised with Avraham
לֹא נִתְקַיְּימוּ לֹא הֵם וְלֹא זַרְעָם
neither they nor their offspring endured
and all the more so the other converts;
to which "from the converts of his father" alludes;
that is, one whom he recognized
so that he and his offspring would remain, etc.
And this is why it says,
"He took Yitzchak and created the world with him":
whose attribute is fear and dread;
and this was the purpose of creation,
"And God has made it so that they should fear Him,"
"for My glory I have created it."
But He saw that it could not endure,
there would be only a very few
who would recognize the power of His Kingship.
"He took Avraham and sustained the world through him":
for he wanted to bring in the whole world,
that they should recognize the power of His Kingship.
And this is what is said (Tehillim 89:3):
מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
the attribute of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
And this is why it says be-hibar'am, be-Avraham.
"He saw that they needed greater endurance":
that is, He saw that they would go astray
וְנִרְאֶה שֶׁאַף בְּחַיֵּי אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And it appears that even in the lifetime of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
וְאַף ז׳ מִצְוֹת לֹא קִיְּימוּ כֻּלָּם
and not all of them even kept the seven commandments;
regarding the disciples of Avraham Avinu
And why did it not say
that the disciples of Avraham Avinu
the seven commandments of the Bnei Noach?
But even the disciples of Avraham Avinu
did not keep the entire Torah as he did,
nor even the seven commandments of the Bnei Noach;
And this is why it lists
וּמִמֵּילָא לֹא הָיוּ פְּרוּצִים כָּל כָּךְ
and consequently they were not so unrestrained,
and the fear of Hashem was upon them.
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן תַּלְמוּדֵי בִּלְעָם הָרָשָׁע
Not so the disciples of the wicked Bilam,
who breached the fence of the nations of the world
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה וּפֵירוּשׁ רַשִׁ״י בָּלָק)
(as stated in the Midrash Rabbah and Rashi's commentary on Balak);
And this is why it says,
מַה בֵּין תַּלְמִידָיו שֶׁל אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ
"What is the difference between the disciples of Avraham Avinu
It would have been more fitting to compare
who were in the same era.
אַךְ זֶה לֹא שַׁיָּיךְ כְּלָל לִשְׁאוֹל
But this one cannot ask at all,
for regarding the lowest in Yisrael
there is no relevance at all
But the disciples of Avraham Avinu
were also not as they should be,
and after his death they returned to their bad ways;
only one who died in his lifetime
And Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
according to his attribute was content
and this was the sustaining of the world,
as it says, "The world is built by kindness"
that is, though they were not as they should be,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם עַל פִּי מִדַּת הַחֶסֶד
nevertheless by the attribute of kindness
But "He saw that they needed greater endurance,"
that they would go astray more each time;
and on what would the world stand?
also in the attribute of the Fear of Yitzchak;
and he merited to rectify the whole blemish,
and the filth ceased with him,
in whom there is no blemish
And this is the main sustaining of the world:
even by the attribute of judgment;
for whoever is of the seed of Yisrael
לֹא יוּכַל לַעֲקוֹר שֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמֶּנּוּ
cannot uproot the name Yisrael from himself,
and it enumerates there all the gravest sins;
For Hashem Yisbarach testifies about Yisrael
that they are bound at the root
to the Holy One, blessed be He,
"Our will is to do Your will;
The leaven in the dough and the subjugation"
who are the root of evil,
נִכְנַס לְלֵב יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּם כֵּן מַה
something enters the heart of Yisrael as well.
And this is what they said (Sukkah 52a):
And through this the world has endurance
even by the attribute of judgment;
the purpose of the making of heaven and earth,
which is the purpose of creation:
the attribute of Malchus, and fear.
for Hashem Yisbarach in His world,
If only you would find favor before Me
as you have found favor before Me
and immediately at the very entry of Shabbos,
"the fear of Shabbos is upon the am ha'aretz"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּיְרוּשַׁלְמִי רֵישׁ פֶּרֶק ד דִּדְמַאי)
(as they said in the Yerushalmi, beginning of Demai ch. 4);
and this is from the attribute of the Fear of Yitzchak.
so that he will not keep Shabbos,
through the attribute of Avraham Avinu.
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ (שׁוֹחֵר טוֹב, תְּהִלִּים צב, א)
And this is what they said (Shocher Tov, Tehillim 92:1):
"And what was created on the seventh?
but it was all holiness and rest," etc.;
that a person sins on it
so that one be counted among "those who desecrate it" (Shemos 31:14).
But after the whole day has passed
זוֹכִין לִקְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
one merits the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
so that the whole world will be rectified.
as before Adam HaRishon went astray;
and when the majority of Yisrael merit this,
